recordStage: Actual native/mobile/card review complete; normal project verification, required CI and actual merge remain separate gates.
setup: Shoulder-harness variation: use a fitted harness and start light.
Set both shoulder pads and bar catches before lifting from a rack.
Keep feet planted; brace before each squat.

advice.tip: Keep the harness supported on both shoulders and the bar secure in its catches.
commonMistakes: Letting the harness tip or lose shoulder contact.
Lifting your heels or letting knees collapse inward.
Losing your brace or leaning far forward.

findings: Two genuine intact squat states repeat across six delivery slots; this is a discrete illustrated guide.
Custom shoulder harness based on a real apparatus principle; not a stock manufacturer replica or ordinary direct-shoulder front rack.
Equipment projection is illustrative; the source body is not calibrated in3D. The old nominal51mm neck-envelope clearance is not adopted.
Original neutral source pixels remain exact; original violet fields use the exact target bases and per-pixel source tone. Neutralised source tint is not recovered pre-tint anatomy.
Retained source plate projections and hand contours have minor illustrative pose differences; a calibrated continuous human movement is not claimed.
Native scoped review uses the actual worn regular-harness reference for medial upper-shoulder support; strict review and exact anatomical depth remain unverified.
Raw playback contains brief image/cue observer transitions; settled selections agree. Preview-reset and truncated-read evidence are preserved beside the successful repeated light playback capture.
